name: Slow Fuse
summary: A hold-to-delete pill with a real fuse burning round its edge; the file card then burns to ash
about: Slow Fuse is a hold-to-delete button for files that must not go by accident. Holding it lights a braided fuse that burns round the pill, spitting sparks, while the label fills with ember colour. Let go early and the fuse puffs out and grows back; hold to the end and a glowing line climbs the card, turning it to embers and ash before it re-forms.
how: Press and hold the button (or hold Space or Enter when it has focus).
A spark runs round the fuse in 1.5 seconds, the label fills with ember colour and the button shivers harder near the end.
Let go early and the fuse puffs smoke and grows back; nothing is deleted.
Hold to the end: sparks burst, a burn line climbs the card and it crumbles into embers and ash.
The slot reads Poster deleted; press Bring it back or wait and the card re-forms with a cool shimmer.
